treaty_name: Agreement between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Sultanate of Oman for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2009)
eif_quote: De bepalingen van het Verdrag, met Protocol, zullen ingevolge artikel 30 in werking treden op 28 december 2011.
source_title: wetten.overheid.nl consolidated text BWBV0004163 (English authentic text, prevailing over Dutch/Arabic; Trb. 2010, 181, corr. Trb. 2019, 171)

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: b) 10 (ten) per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: a) 0 (zero) per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 (ten) per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 (eight) per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Art. 30(a): for taxes withheld at source, effective for amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January following entry into force (2011-12-28 -> 2012-01-01). Not modelled: Art. 10(8)-(10) - for 0%-tier dividends paid by a Dutch company, if Omani taxation of the dividends is below 10% the Netherlands may levy up to 10%, unless the Omani recipient company is wholly government-owned, listed on the Oman stock exchange or engaged in an active trade or business in Oman (or competent authorities agree it is not set up mainly to obtain the benefit); Art. 10(4) residence-only taxation for the State, political subdivisions, pension funds, central banks, State General Reserve Fund, Omani Investment Fund, Omani Development Bank etc.; Protocol I(a): no treaty benefits for free-zone exempt companies and income from them; Protocol XIII(b) NL preserving assessment (conserverende aanslag) on substantial-interest dividends. The 0% dividend tier is drafted as a cap of 0 per cent (max_rate 0, not exclusive). MLI art 8 (365-day holding) does NOT apply: Oman reserved the entirety of Art. 8 under Art. 8(3)(a) (Oman MLI position at deposit, 7 July 2020, page 15; read from the scanned OECD PDF). Oman lists the NL treaty as agreement no. 17. MLI PPT from 2021-01-01 per treaties_merged.json (MLI Art. 35(1)(a)); MLI Art. 7(1) text cited from the official Dutch publication of the MLI.
